content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) Technical Tutorial"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) is a comprehensive approach to securing enterprise applications, networks, and infrastructure against cyber threats. While vulnerability assessment focuses on identifying and classifying security weaknesses, penetration testing actively exploits those weaknesses to measure the real-world impact of a breach."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Phase 1: Vulnerability Assessment"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"The vulnerability assessment phase relies heavily on automated tools to scan systems for known software vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and outdated patches. Network administrators typically use scanners like OpenVAS or Nessus for this step."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"nmap -sS -sV -p- -T4 target_ip_address"},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"-sS: Performs a stealthy SYN scan to determine open ports."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"-sV: Probes open ports to determine service and version information."},{"order":8,"type":"bullet_point","text":"-p-: Scans all 65535 ports on the target machine."},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"Phase 2: Penetration Testing Methodology"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"Once vulnerabilities are identified, penetration testing takes a proactive approach. Ethical hackers simulate sophisticated cyber attacks to bypass security controls. The process follows five standard stages: Reconnaissance, Scanning, Gaining Access, Maintaining Access, and Covering Tracks."},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"When testing web applications, security professionals often check for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, such as SQL Injection (SQLi) and Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"sqlmap -u \"http://target.com/vulnerable.php?id=1\" --dbs"},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Phase 3: Remediation and Reporting"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"The final stage of VAPT involves compiling the findings into a comprehensive executive and technical report. The technical report should detail the vulnerability severity (Critical, High, Medium, Low), the proof of concept, and actionable remediation steps."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Prioritize patching based on exploitability and business asset value."},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Implement continuous monitoring to detect zero-day exploits quickly."},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Conduct regular re-testing to ensure identified vulnerabilities have been properly resolved."}]
